newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hills Industries sees profit rising.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hills Industries sees profit rising.

text.p: Hills Industries Ltd said on Friday that profit and sales in the first four months of 1996/97 were ahead of last year and a higher first half profit was also expected.
The diversified manufacturer of outdoor rotary clothes hoists, antennas and other metal products said it was also confident about the full year result.

"We expect the full year's figures to be reasonable providing the improved economic conditions promised by our politicians are realised. Surely they must get it right eventually," chairman Bob Ling told the annual meeting.
